title: Sol y Sombra | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Watercolor Home: * Prime Location: A rare find- Watercolor home located on the South side of 30A*Just steps away from Watercolor Beach Club and Private Beach Access*Access to exclusive Watercolor amenities including Beach Club, Camp Watercolor, Tennis
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Watercolor Home: * Prime Location: A rare find- Watercolor home located on the South side of 30A*Just steps away from Watercolor Beach Club and Private Beach Access*Access to exclusive Watercolor amenities including Beach Club, Camp Watercolor, Tennis Center, and more!*3rd Floor Master Suite Includes Wet Bar, Mini Fridge, and Microwave * 4 Bikes Included – A Short bike ride to picturesque Seaside* Professionally Managed, 24/7 service*This luxurious home is not available to parties of adults under age 25, with no exceptions. *Welcome to Sol Y Sombra, a beautiful four-bedroom, four-bathroom home located in the desirable exclusive WaterColor Community. This thoughtfully designed retreat offers comfort and style across three levels, with the third floor featuring a luxurious king master suite complete with a wet bar, mini fridge, microwave, private bathroom, cozy sitting area, and a private balcony with stunning partial Gulf views. The second floor boasts a spacious living and dining area that opens to an expansive porch overlooking the state forest and Western Lake, along with a well-equipped kitchen perfect for preparing delicious meals. Guests enjoy full access to all WaterColor amenities, including three resort-style pools, scenic nature trails, beach access, and more! Come make lasting memories at Sol Y Sombra.The newly redesigned Camp WaterColor pool area offers three different pool options. One pool offers zero entry access, a large splash pad with interactive dancing water jets to entertain the younger kids, and a small water slide for the younger kids. This pool was designed with families in mind. Another pool offers a waterslide for older kids, and the whole family will enjoy the lazy river, food service, bar area, and arcade. Your kids will love the scheduled activities!Bed Setup: First Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed – Private Bathroom Guest Bedroom 2: Queen Bed - Private BathroomSecond Floor:Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed- Private BathroomThird Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed- Private BathroomArea Attractions: Seaside is a fantastic destination within walking distance and is most widely known for being featured in The Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It's incredible architecture has helped to make it famous, but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
